about_the_game:
📦 It’s moving day! Start by cleaning up each house, removing trash and getting rooms ready for a fresh start. Then unpack boxes filled with random furniture and decor, moving items between rooms and placing them on floors, walls, or furniture with smooth drag-and-drop. Gentle client requests add playful challenges, while every piece you place unlocks new items for Sandbox mode.

Begin with small cozy homes and progress to larger houses with guestrooms, game rooms, gyms, and more. When you’re done, use Camera Mode to capture your designs - adjust angles, lighting, and backgrounds to share your creations in the perfect light. Cozy, replayable, and pressure-free, Moving Day makes every move a new story.

Features

  • 🧹 Clean and prepare each home by removing trash and mopping.

  • 📦 Unpack random furniture and decor for fresh setups every time.

  • 🏡 Move items freely between rooms to find the perfect fit.

  • 🎯 Gentle client requests add optional challenges and variety.

  • 🛋️ Unlock every item you place for endless creativity in Sandbox mode.

  • 🏠 Progression from starter homes to larger houses with more rooms to furnish.

  • 📸 Camera Mode to adjust angles, lighting, and backgrounds for perfect cozy screenshots.

  • ✨ Relaxing, pressure-free decorating with smooth animations and sound effects.

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (4th gen) or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4400 / AMD Radeon R7 / NVIDIA GTX 660
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
